title: Create src/commands/new.ts handler skeleton
description: Implement the 'rocket new' command handler. If no project name is provided, render an Ink TextInput to prompt for one. Then pass control to the NewProjectWizard TUI component.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket new (no args) prompts user for project name via TextInput
rocket new my-app skips the name prompt and proceeds to project type selection
Handler correctly passes projectName to the wizard TUI

steps.details: Import render from ink and NewProjectWizard TUI (stub or real). If projectName is undefined, render a TextInput prompt. On input submit, proceed to NewProjectWizard with the name.

Create a simple Ink component for the name prompt: `function NamePrompt({ onSubmit }: { onSubmit: (name: string) => void }) { const [name, setName] = useState(''); return (<Box><Text>Project name: </Text><TextInput value={name} onChange={setName} onSubmit={onSubmit} /></Box>) }`. Render this before the wizard.

steps.description: Transition to NewProjectWizard after name input
steps.details: After the name is provided (either from args or from the prompt), render NewProjectWizard with { projectName }. The wizard handles the rest of the scaffolding flow.
Run `npm run dev -- new` and verify a name prompt appears. Run `npm run dev -- new my-test-app` and verify the wizard starts directly with 'my-test-app' as the project name.

technicalNotes: Ink components render in the terminal using React — import { render } from 'ink' and render(<Component />)
TextInput from ink-text-input calls onSubmit when the user presses Enter
